market_question: Will Yang Seung-jo win the 2026 Chungcheongnam Province gubernatorial election?
reasoning: Yang Seung-jo was the Democratic Party nominee in 2022 and received 46.2% of the vote, a competitive showing. Given his name recognition and the party's reasonable chance of winning the governorship in a likely competitive 2026 midterm, his true probability is at least a few percent. The market price of 0.8% appears overly pessimistic, even accounting for nomination uncertainty.
evidence_points: 2022 Chungcheongnam-do governor election: Kim Tae-heum (PPP) 53.8% vs Yang Seung-jo (DP) 46.2%
South Korean local elections often swing with national sentiment; Democratic Party could be competitive in June 2026
Specific-candidate markets far from election typically suffer from low liquidity and underconfidence, creating drift from fair value
sources_consulted: National Election Commission (nec.go.kr) – 2022 provincial election results
General knowledge of South Korean political party dynamics and election cycles
